title: Nash/Old Hickory-Johnny Cash’s Place at the Lake
description:
This one-of-a-kind, Johnny Cash–inspired retreat sits on Old Hickory Lake where Cash once lived! 

Just steps from the marina and a short drive to Nashville. This home blends music, meaning, and memorable moments into an experience guests cherish forever! 

⭑All essentials provided. 
⭑Kitchen stocked with cooking basics & rooftop lake views!
⭑Boat owners welcome! 
⭑1 min walk to Blue Turtle Bay Marina. 
⭑Rentals, trailer parking & overnight docking avail!
⭑Kayaks included + Garage game room!

The space
This is a 3 story unit with a 4th floor rooftop patio! 

Please note: This townhouse has three staircases Guests should be comfortable navigating stairs.

📍 THE LAYOUT 📍

First floor: Front Entry, spare room/office, and garage (converts to a game room!)

Second floor: Kitchen, Living room, bedroom, full bathroom, two balconies.

Third floor: Master bedroom, bathroom, and walk in closet and third bedroom with closet and en suite bathroom. Washer & Dryer

Fourth floor: Accessed by interior stairs with open air rooftop patio with bistro lighting and lake views!

Guests have access to the whole home, including attached 2-car garage.  Overflow street parking avail.

Game room details: Garage Fridge, fold away ping pong table, dart board, giant Jenga, connect 4, board games, and more!

🎶 THE CASH EXPERIENCE 🎶

Inspired by Johnny Cash — beyond the music

This home reflects not just the legend, but the life behind it — themes of love, struggle, resilience, and redemption woven thoughtfully throughout the space. Some details are bold. Others are quietly waiting to be found.

🛏 Thoughtfully designed sleeping spaces

The home offers four private sleeping rooms plus additional sleeping options:

Center Stage
The Promise
The Joint
The Way (first-floor private room with pull-out sofa)

💤 Additional sleeping:

Pull-out sofa in the main living area
Comfortably suited for 6–8 guests, with flexibility for up to 10.

☕ The Coffee Bar — a moment of paradise

Start your morning with a nod to one of Johnny Cash’s most personal reflections:

“This morning, having coffee with her.”
A simple reminder to slow down and savor the moment.

🔥 The Ring of Fire Rooftop Deck

Your favorite gathering space — day or night:
- Bistro lights
- Tabletop fire pit
- Lake views

Perfect for coffee at sunrise overlooking the lake or drinks under the stars

🎯 Game Room for all ages

Ping pong, darts, giant Jenga, Connect 4, board games, and a fridge — great for families, friends, and late-night fun.

Guest access
You have access to the entire property!

- All 3 levels
- Rooftop deck
- Game room
- Kitchen and living spaces

We’re also happy to share local tips — whether it’s boating to Nashville or finding the best spots nearby.

DID YOU KNOW: Adventurous boaters can even travel to Nashville’s Broadway Street by boat with a day trip from the townhome/marina, through Old Hickory Lock and Dam and down the Cumberland to the downtown Nashville municipal docks.  If this day-long boating adventure and Nashville visit is in your plans, please message Kelli for tips on planning your trip!

Other things to note
Please note:
No large parties are allowed. 
No illegal substances on property. 
No pets
Thank you!

🎵 Just like Johnny Cash’s life, some of the most meaningful moments aren’t the ones on display — they’re the ones you discover along the way.
